💸 PayPal is back on Gumroad + 🔗 UTM links + 💰 0% default tip
January 30, 2025
Hey there!
Hope you're doing well. We're thrilled to announce that PayPal is back on Gumroad! Our teams have worked together to restore both payment and payout functionality. You can count on PayPal being available on Gumroad moving forward.
If you had a PayPal account set up before, everything has been restored and there's no action you need to take. You may have already seen some PayPal sales come through!
We've also added a UTM links feature to help you track traffic, revenue, and conversion rate across marketing channels.
You can create UTM links from
the dashboard
or on the fly by adding utm_source, utm_medium, and utm_campaign parameters to URLs of any of your product, post, profile, or subscribe pages. We'll auto-create a UTM link for you the first time someone uses the link.
Also, by popular demand, we've changed the default tip to 0%. You can enable tipping from
your checkout form dashboard
.
Best,
The Gumroad Team
